evals.prompt: /create-rule api-errors "Standard error handling for API routes" -- this is a Claude Code project with an existing CLAUDE.md and code under src/api/
assertions: Detects the project already uses Claude Code conventions (CLAUDE.md present) rather than defaulting to AGENTS.md or Cursor format
Creates .claude/rules/api-errors.md as a new file rather than appending to CLAUDE.md
The new file's frontmatter includes a paths glob scoped to the API directory (e.g. src/api/**/*.ts or equivalent), not left unscoped
The rule body uses imperative language with concrete guidelines specific to API error handling, not generic placeholder text
CLAUDE.md itself is not given paths frontmatter (paths frontmatter is only valid on .claude/rules/*.md files)

evals.prompt: /create-rule preferences "functional programming patterns, async/await over promises -- this is just for me across all my projects, not the team"
assertions: Recognizes this is a user-scope (personal) rule rather than project-scope, from the 'just for me across all my projects' language
Writes the rule under ~/.claude/rules/ (user scope) rather than ./.claude/rules/ (project scope, shared via git)
Does not stage or commit the new file with git, since user-scope rules are personal and not team-shared
The rule content reflects the stated preferences (functional patterns, async/await) rather than generic boilerplate unrelated to what was asked

evals.prompt: /create-rule testing "table-driven tests, no shared state between tests" -- the repo only has an AGENTS.md at the root, no CLAUDE.md and no .claude directory anywhere
assertions: Detects that the repo uses the AGENTS.md convention rather than defaulting to CLAUDE.md/.claude/rules since no Claude-specific files exist
Appends a new section to the existing AGENTS.md instead of creating a separate rule file, since AGENTS.md has no per-topic file-splitting convention
Does not add YAML frontmatter to the AGENTS.md entry (AGENTS.md supports none)
Does not create a .claude/rules directory or a new CLAUDE.md file that didn't previously exist

evals.prompt: /create-rule error-handling "always wrap errors with context" -- brand new empty repo, no CLAUDE.md, no AGENTS.md, no .claude or .cursor directories anywhere
assertions: Detects that no memory/rule convention file exists anywhere in the repo
Does not guess a tool or format and does not create any file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/*, or .cursor/rules/*) before asking the user
The final response asks the user which tool/convention to target (e.g. Claude Code, AGENTS.md-style, or Cursor) and stops there
No Write, Edit, or mutating Bash command (mkdir, git add, etc.) is executed before that question is answered
